From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@acmehealth.com>, Marcus Doyle <marcus.doyle@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock demo window + define evaluation sprint and prompt pack

Hi Samantha / Marcus —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Acme Health's two priority workflows (clinical note summarization & billing-code suggestion). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an evaluation started next week: 

Key takeaways from discovery:
- Primary success metric: 80%+ relevance on billing-code suggestions (measured against your 6k historical records).
- Latency requirement: 95th percentile <= 300ms for single-record inference during peak.
- Data flow: we'll run a privacy-preserving eval using de-identified samples you provide; no PHI leaves your environment if you use S3 transfer method.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
1) Lock a 60-minute demo + technical deep-dive for Tues/Wed next week — I proposed three windows below.
2) I’ll share an evaluation charter and a prompt-pack template for you to populate (we'll prepare an initial prompt set for the trial).
3) Assign trial owners & success criteria in the kickoff — you mentioned Marcus for clinical side and Samantha for procurement.
4) Security/compliance: please share the SOC 2 contact or the security questionnaire owner so we can coordinate pre-kickoff.

Available demo/kill-switch windows (Pacific TZ):
- Tue May 11 — 09:00–10:00 PT
- Tue May 11 — 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed May 12 — 11:00–12:00 PT

If none of these work, propose two alternatives and we’ll re-align. Once we have a time, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda (demo, deep-dive on prompts & data, success criteria, and next steps).

Attachments: acme-eval-charter.pdf (draft), prompt-pack-template.csv (empty columns for intent/examples/expected_output).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Thanks Hannah — great recap. Tue May 11 at 13:00 PT works best for our team.

Quick notes/questions before the kickoff:
- Procurement timeline: we need a pricing estimate and standard SOW by EOD Friday to present to finance. Can you attach that?
- Data handoff: Marcus will own de-identification and can drop a sample CSV in the S3 bucket this week. Marcus — can you confirm ETA?
- Security lead: sending to you in a separate email (we'll loop in our InfoSec contact).
